status: Source/synthetic draft; separate source-freeze execution_ready receipt required before any cache numeric read. No static/dynamic learner changes.
cache_semantics: Original120 IDs only, original232 weights with5%grid+exactthirds, exact0.25% annual-restoration cost including inception. Retain strict172 all-three-assets>=.05 and explicit original232/local mapping. Cache is read directly after integrity validation; no raw data parser/cache generator is imported or run.

metadata_design.jobs: Exactly30 saved own-training jobs:6contexts(full120 plus5outer96), each4inner+1refit. Reuse fixed saved menus, gamma selection and effective labels, not refit new choices.
metadata_design.rows: 30×5=150 fit-profile metadata rows,30 saved gamma objective-band records and full saved menu/completion descriptions.
metadata_design.interpretation: Raw versus effective assignment and Review reasons stay separate. Gamma objective ties are not automatically behavior equivalence. Product names refer to saved15year reference risk ordering, not guaranteed ordering at every horizon.
metadata_design.stability: All jobs/targets/parameters remain visible with their training IDs. Overlapping fits are not independent deployment trials; no pooled confidence interval or unique risk preference is inferred.

individual_set_design.groups: For every job/profile, two clearly named groups: selected_gamma and fixed service_alpha_reference=.10. Total30×5×2=300 set summaries. If selected_gamma=NULL, its set fields are NULL/no_selected_gamma, not an empty feasible universe; fixedalpha remains an independent diagnostic group.
individual_set_design.feasibility: Use only currentjob training IDs. Empirical strict MDD-L>1e-12 count must be<=floor(gamma*n+1e-12), and billsweight>=declared liquidityfloor-1e-12. Report the effective count cap, complete feasible local IDs and local/original mappings.
individual_set_design.individual_best: Among that profile feasible targets maximize training mean annual real log growth. This ignores the shared-three-product catalogue constraint and is not a new jointly optimal common menu.
individual_set_design.near_optimal_band: Retain every feasible target with G>=individual_best-.001-1e-12. Epsilon=.001 is fixed0.1percentagepoint annual LOG-growth tolerance, not exactly0.1pp CAGR, not a fitted preference and not adjusted after results.
individual_set_design.outputs: Complete near-set membership with weight vectors, training event counts, mean G and gaps; per-asset minima/maxima and maximum pairwise total-variation distance (half L1); raw current menu index, training feasibility/growth/regret and near-set inclusion where meaningful.
individual_set_design.no_recommendation_change: Never select a representative member using outer outcomes; do not overwrite the common menu, label a diagnostic individual best as deployable or infer that a broad set proves all its members generalize.

own_horizon_OOF.cohort: Five outer refits each24IDs partition original120 once; everyprofile yields120 rows, giving600 model scenario-profile records and600 exact-thirds reference records. Do not pool five correlated profile copies or horizons as IID.
own_horizon_OOF.policy: Evaluate only each saved effective assigned product on cached static annual-restoration path at original profileH. Review keeps candidate/financialNULL. Product references continue restoration after L crossing; they are not dynamic pending policies or Q2execution approvals.
own_horizon_OOF.horizons: A5/B15/C30/D25/E6, each ownL/liquidity, original100realpeak. No C30 risk value is copied to other customers.
own_horizon_OOF.references: Exactthirds at the same profileH on all120 and on identical assigned originalIDs; four event-ID partitions and paired mean log-growth on the latter. No heldout weight optimization.
own_horizon_OOF.metrics: Median/P10 realCAGR, mean annual logG, median/P90 realMDD, fractional worst10%CVaR90, empirical L events, ordinary real-return volatility, nominal fees and actual trade fraction. Empty financial cohorts retainNULL.
own_horizon_OOF.denominators: Perprofile original120, financial_n, review_n and coverage; all-original reference vs same-assigned reference distinguish conditional policy comparisons. Different profileH cannot be directly interpreted as equal-horizon portfolio ranking.

engineering_gate: docs/q1_stability_diagnostic_source_freeze.json binds this protocolSHA, all executable/test/dependency sourceSHA and all4inputSHA; execution_ready=true required before np.load. Start/end file hashes, cachemetadata hash/IDs/grid/cost, exact30job identities and every saved menu mapping are checked. Existing output is never overwritten; failures retainreceipt/traceback.
limitations: Fixed-grid and representative-profile diagnostic on extensively reused development scenarios. No new model is fitted, no previous final file is read, and unchanged historical independence limitations remain. Static product references and individual feasible sets do not certify autonomous performance, future10%risk or expenditure-funded liquidity.
historical_baseline: Current共同三产品菜单及已有V2/V2b decisions are not changed by this diagnostic; any later adoption from these findings is a separately versioned study.
